verdict: A clean, well-tuned and well-understood slot, but a Wolf Gold-style coin respin in bee costume whose respin presentation hides the locked cells and whose full-comb climax is effectively out of reach.
pros: Every measured band passes, and the feature is well sized: 1 in 118 spins, a 49× average win, a 43% RTP share.
The trigger is simple and well understood: '6 honey cells' with values shown on lock and a '3 respins' Start card. The blind player got top pay, trigger, wild and feature all right.
Clean, consistent flat art, with clear single-win labels ('Sunflower ×4 · 54 ways = 1.96'), winners boxed and the rest dimmed.
Honey cells filling the comb is a natural fit for hold-and-respin.
cons: Keep locked honey cells fixed and visible through every respin, with their ×N badges, and spin only the empty positions. Today all 25 cells spin as normal reels, so the locked honey vanishes and respins look like base spins.

The wild's text 'Worker bee. Stands in for every symbol except honey cells.' is 10 tokens and was hidden. Cut it to under 9, e.g. 'Worker bee: wild, not for honey cells.' Then make the Worker bee clearly unlike the Queen bee (a different body colour or a 'WILD' tag).

Replace the ambiguous 'Harvest 1 · 3 left' with 'Respins left: 3' plus a 'Comb 9/25' fill counter. State the cell values (×1 to ×500), the 1,000× full-comb bonus and the 2,000× cap on the intro card and paytable. Merge the Total win and Big Win cards so the second one doesn't count up from 0.00.

Give the theme its own twist rather than a stock coin respin, e.g. honey that spreads to an adjacent empty cell on each blank respin, so a full comb becomes a reachable climax. Add an honest tease when 4–5 cells show and the reels still to stop can complete 6.
confusions: The worker bee's paytable description was hidden; I had to infer from wins that it is a wild.
During respins the locked honey cells disappear: all 25 positions spin as normal reels, so you cannot see what is held until the reels stop.
The counter 'Harvest 1 . 3 left' / '2 . 2 left' / '3 . 1 left' is ambiguous: is the first number the respin played or the cells? The feature ended with '1 left' still showing.
